lines.beaver: 요즘 장마철이라 비가 정말 많이 오네요.
lines.beaver_en: It's the rainy season, so it rains so much lately.
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum jangmacheorira biga jeongmal mani oneyo.
lines.en: Yes, the humidity is high, so it's really muggy.

lines.beaver_en: What are you doing this weekend? Any plans?
lines.learner: 한강에 나들이 갈까 말까 하고 있어요.
lines.en: I'm wondering whether to go on an outing to the Han River.
lines.roman: hangange nadeuri galkka malkka hago isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 비 올 수도 있는데, 예보를 보지 그래요?
lines.beaver_en: It might rain. Why don't you check the forecast?
lines.beaver_roman: bi ol sudo inneunde, yeboreul boji geuraeyo?
lines.learner: 아직 안 봤어요. 미리 볼걸 그랬어요.
lines.en: I haven't yet. I should have checked earlier.
lines.roman: ajik an bwasseoyo. miri bolgeol geuraesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: They say there'll be showers Saturday, with thunder too.
lines.en: Really? It'd be dangerous if there's lightning.

lines.beaver_en: Yes, and they say typhoons are frequent this summer.
lines.en: Lots of typhoons this summer, huh. How about Sunday?

lines.beaver_en: They say it'll clear up on Sunday.
lines.learner: 다행이네요. 날이 개고 햇빛 좋을 때 가야겠어요.
lines.en: What a relief. I'll go when it clears and it's sunny.
lines.roman: dahaengineyo. nari gaego haetbit joeul ttae gayagesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: It'll be a bit cool in the morning.
lines.learner: 선선하면 좋죠. 일출 보러 갈까 말까 해요.
lines.en: Cool is nice. I'm wondering whether to go see the sunrise.
lines.roman: seonseonhamyeon jochyo. ilchul boreo galkka malkka haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Sounds nice. But it'll be chilly at dawn.
lines.en: Then I'll bring a jacket. Want to come along?

lines.beaver: 좋아요! 그런데 무슨 계절을 제일 좋아해요?
lines.beaver_en: Sure! By the way, which season do you like best?
lines.beaver_roman: joayo! geureonde museun gyejeoreul jeil joahaeyo?
lines.learner: 저는 사계절 중에 겨울이 제일 좋아요.
lines.en: Of the four seasons, I like winter best.
lines.roman: jeoneun sagyejeol junge gyeouri jeil joayo.

lines.beaver_en: Then let's hang out in winter too!
lines.en: Great. Let's build a snowman at the first snow!
